source.snippet: Amazon FBA sellers want a fast automated audit of their product listing (title, bullets, backend keywords, image checklist) against current best practices, instead of paying a consultant.

problem_statement: Amazon FBA sellers want a fast automated audit of their product listing (title, bullets, backend keywords, image checklist) against current best practices, instead of paying a consultant.
notes: Buyer with money: FBA sellers already pay for Helium 10 and Jungle Scout ($40-100/mo). Automatable: paste an ASIN/listing, Claude returns a scored audit + rewrite suggestions as a report. No human work per order. Recurring as sellers add SKUs.
